about.title: About EnOX
about.lead: We're building the operating system for sustainable real-estate.
about.body: EnOX was founded because energy is too important to be stuck in silos. We combine classic energy consulting with smart-building technology so owners, investors and companies can plan efficiency, then operate and scale it long-term. Our interdisciplinary team of energy consultants, architects, engineers and software specialists thinks internationally and works to dena, KfW and EU standards.
